screen.title: Announcement: Alumni mentoring program
screen.prompt: Listen to an announcement made to students.

audio.text: Attention, third- and fourth-year students. Applications are now open for the alumni mentoring program, which pairs you with a graduate who works in your field for one semester. Mentors and students usually meet online once a month. The program has room for sixty pairs, and last year more than two hundred students applied, so please don't wait until the deadline on November fifteenth.

questions.stem: What is the alumni mentoring program?
options: A class taught by graduates during the summer
A plan that matches students with former students in their field
A job fair where companies meet fourth-year students
A monthly online meeting that is open to every third-year student in the school

why.en: Detail (paraphrase of "pairs you with a graduate who works in your field"). D misuses "online once a month", which describes the meetings of each pair; A and C are not mentioned.
why.tr: Ayrıntı ("pairs you with a graduate who works in your field" ifadesinin parafrazı). D her eşin buluşmalarını anlatan "online once a month" ifadesini yanlış kullanıyor; A ve C hiç geçmiyor.
why.es: Detalle (paráfrasis de "pairs you with a graduate who works in your field"). D usa mal "online once a month", que describe las reuniones de cada pareja; A y C no se mencionan.

questions.stem: Why does the speaker mention last year's applications?
options: To show that the program is likely to fill up
To explain why the deadline has been moved
To announce that the program will accept more pairs
To thank students for their interest last year

why.en: Function: more than two hundred applicants for sixty places shows that space runs out, so students should apply early. B and C are not stated; D is not the point.
why.tr: İşlev: altmış yer için iki yüzden fazla başvuru, yerlerin dolduğunu gösteriyor; öğrenciler erken başvurmalı. B ve C söylenmiyor; D asıl amaç değil.
why.es: Función: más de doscientas solicitudes para sesenta plazas muestra que las plazas se agotan, así que conviene presentarse pronto. B y C no se dicen; D no es la idea.
